subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should OpenClaw accept a `groupScope`-style core config for folding selected group/channel peers into the agent main session, and what security/audit/proof gates are required before the linked implementation can land?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the request adds a core config surface that changes transcript/session trust boundaries, so maintainer product and security intent is required before implementation is treated as ready.

options.title: Review linked PR with security gates
options.body: Proceed with the linked implementation direction only after maintainers settle audit/docs posture, inbound/outbound parity, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow to binding-only or named sessions
options.body: Reject a broad global group-to-main default for now and sponsor a narrower per-binding or named shared-session design.

options.title: Defer to broader shared-session design
options.body: Keep this issue open as focused context while maintainers design the broader shared-session contract in related trackers.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR with security gates
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked implementation direction only after maintainers settle audit/docs posture, inbound/outbound parity, and real behavior proof.
